entries.name: Lower Bailey West Canvas Shelter
entries.review: Independent small canvas shelter beside the west curtain, visible around source pixels [423,2065,52,58] and linked by mask 6. The model inventory contains only the neighbouring wall and cottage in this area; neither owns this shelter. The thin sloped physical roof is independent. The visible front pole extends from the roof's eastern corner to the ground; its visual geometry adds no collision. Texture, remaining timber details and roof-edge mask coverage remain unfinished.
